q613788.dateNote: The year shown is only rough: Wikidata gives "13th century". German merchants founded the church some time in the 1200s.

q937320.dateNote: Only "13th century" is known (shown as 1201). The Danes probably built the first church in the 1220s.

q866154.dateNote: Only "13th century" is known (shown as 1201). It was built after the bishop moved here in the later 1200s.

q727809.dateNote: First written mention in 1209. The church has been rebuilt many times since; the tower was rebuilt after it burned in 1941.

q1497616.dateNote: Only "14th century" is known for the first castle (shown as 1301). Today's brick tower dates from about 1409.

q37333.dateNote: The year shown, 1317, is when Lublin got town rights. It is first mentioned in the late 1100s, and people lived here long before.
